shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' -g '"'!build'"' | sed -n '1,120p' && printf '\\n--- top-level manifests ---\\n' && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f \\( -name package.json -o -name vite.config.* -o -name next.config.* -o -name tsconfig.json \\) -print"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---' && cat package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- app files ---' && find app lib -maxdepth 4 -type f -print -exec sh -c 'echo \"--- "'$1"; sed -n "1,240p" "$1"'"' _ {} \\;"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- React view transition symbols ---' && rg -n \"ViewTransition|viewTransitionName|startViewTransition\" node_modules/react node_modules/@types/react node_modules/next | sed -n '1,220p' && printf '%s\\n' '--- Next navigation/link transition references ---' && rg -n \"viewTransition|ViewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/client node_modules/next/dist/shared node_modules/next/types* 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- Link types ---\\n' && rg -n \"transitionTypes\" node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts node_modules/next/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,100p' && printf '\\n--- React runtime exports ---\\n' && node -e \"import('react').then(r=>console.log({ViewTransition:typeof r.ViewTransition, addTransitionType:typeof r.addTransitionType, version:r.version}))\""

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"viewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/components -g '*.js' -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,220p' && printf '\\n--- package tree ---\\n' && npm ls next react react-dom --depth=0"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n--- diff stat ---\\n' && git diff --stat && printf '\\n--- tsconfig diff ---\\n' && git diff -- tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- transition-related diff ---\\n' && git diff -- next.config.ts react-canary.d.ts app/template.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css | sed -n '1,360p'"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && git show HEAD:package.json && printf '\\n--- next-env ---\\n' && cat next-env.d.ts && printf '\\n--- gitignore ---\\n' && cat .gitignore && printf '\\n--- template ---\\n' && nl -ba app/template.tsx && printf '\\n--- react declaration ---\\n' && cat react-canary.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"paths\": {
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
-    }
+    \"paths\": {
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
+    }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba next.config.ts; printf '\\n'; nl -ba app/template.tsx; printf '\\n'; nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx; printf '\\n'; nl -ba 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' | sed -n '30,90p'; printf '\\n'; nl -ba app/page.tsx; printf '\\n'; nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '120,250p'; printf '\\n--- final status ---\\n'; git status --short"
